name: be ok
source:
What does it take to be ok with yourself?

In this story you get to be with 5 characters who experience this

A story about finding and accepting yourself while learning and developing as a person

[From [url=https://mayelenym.itch.io/be-ok]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
到底要怎样，才能和自己好好相处？

在这个故事里，你会陪着五个角色，一起经历这件事。

这是一个关于寻找自我、接纳自我，也在这个过程中不断学习、慢慢成长的故事。

［摘自[url=https://mayelenym.itch.io/be-ok]Itch.io[/url]］
